decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and countering their spells while maintaining card advantage. Using a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and eventually win the game through incremental advantage. The inclusion of creatures like Gurmag Angler and Spellstutter Sprite provides additional threats and ways to interact with the opponent's board. Overall, the deck seeks to dictate the pace of the game and grind out a victory through careful resource management and control.

The main idea of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with small, evasive creatures like Faeries and Ninjas, while also disrupting their plans with Counterspells and other cheap interaction spells. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, using tempo plays to maintain control of the game and ultimately win through incremental damage. It relies on efficient card draw and tempo plays to outpace opponents and maintain a strong board presence.

This Jund aggro deck relies on sacrificing creatures to gain value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Krark-Clan Shaman and Fanatical Offering, the deck can generate card advantage and control the board. Constants like Writhing Chrysalis and Ichor Wellspring offer additional sacrifice targets, while removal spells like Cast Down and Snuff Out help keep the opponent's threats in check. With the ability to generate tokens and draw cards through sacrificing, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and finish them off with direct damage spells like Fireblast and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes card draw spells like Faithless Looting to maintain hand advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells to secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this Aggro - Affinity deck is to quickly swarm the board with cheap artifacts and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite. The deck utilizes cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast to keep the card flow going, while also including disruptive cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Metallic Rebuke to control the opponent's strategy. The mana base is primarily made up of artifact lands to support the affinity mechanic and ensure a smooth mana curve. Candy Trail and Blood Fountain provide additional support and synergy with the artifact theme.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and removal spells to control the board while setting up for explosive plays with cards like Fanatical Offering and Writhing Chrysalis. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures and disruption, using cards like Refurbished Familiar and Nyxborn Hydra for aggression while disrupting the opponent's plans with cards like Cast Down and Cleansing Wildfire. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Pulse of Murasa and Lembas to outvalue the opponent in longer games.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, backed up by sacrifice effects to gain value. The deck aims to control the board through targeted removal and disruption while also generating card advantage through sacrificing artifacts and creatures. By utilizing a mix of discard and sacrifice effects, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own threats to close out the game quickly. The key is to efficiently use resources and tempo to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board using various removal spells and combo pieces, while ramping up to assemble the Urzatron lands for massive mana advantage. By utilizing cards like Expedition Map and Ichor Wellspring to search for lands and draw cards, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating more resources. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Crypt Rats and Fangren Marauder provide additional board control and life gain options. The deck also includes some recursion options with Haunted Fengraf and Nihil Spellbomb to help maintain card advantage and disrupt opponent strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with efficient and powerful Elf creatures, utilizing mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania to ramp up quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of Elves and pump them up with cards like Timberwatch Elf to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help to refill the hand with more Elves, ensuring a steady stream of threats for the opponent to deal with.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost black creatures and sacrifice effects, in order to pump up key creatures and deal damage efficiently. Utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures, sacrifice outlets, and card draw, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and maintain card advantage. With a low mana curve and plenty of ways to recur or sacrifice creatures, the deck aims to control the board and close out the game as quickly as possible while steadily growing in power.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining card advantage. By utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Faeries and Ninjas, along with counterspells and bounce effects, the deck aims to control the board and apply pressure at the same time. The goal is to keep the opponent on the back foot and prevent them from stabilizing, ultimately securing victory through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures and counter spells to disrupt their game plan. By utilizing cards that can bounce back to your hand like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Moon-Circuit Hacker, you can maintain card advantage while putting pressure on your opponent. The deck has a focus on flying creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Spellstutter Sprite to get in damage quickly and efficiently. Overall, the goal is to control the game tempo and win through fast and evasive attacks.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with cheap, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards that provide card advantage like Brainstorm and Ponder, along with tempo plays like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the game while aggressing with creatures like Cryptic Serpent and Delver of Secrets. Tolarian Terror and Sleep of the Dead provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to stabilize and find an answer to the relentless pressure of the Mono Blue Aggro strategy.

The focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly deploy cheap creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent while disrupting opponents with counterspells and bounce spells. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as graveyard recursion with cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis. By combining early aggression with control elements, the deck can apply pressure to opponents while still having the ability to interact with their game plan.

The main focus of this Red Deck Wins aggro archetype is to quickly deploy low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. Utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The goal is to create a fast-paced and aggressive gameplay style that puts pressure on the opponent and forces them to react quickly or risk losing the game.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize walls with defender to generate large amounts of mana, allowing you to cast powerful spells and combo off with cards like Freed from the Real. By generating an abundance of mana, you can quickly overwhelm your opponent and take control of the game. The deck also features card draw and recursion to ensure you have the necessary resources to execute your combo efficiently. Additionally, there are some utility creatures and spells included to provide flexibility and resilience in different game situations.
